title: Map labelling #8
topic: museum · botanical garden · university campus · wildlife park
context:
Narrator: Map 1. The museum.
Guide: Welcome to the museum. I will quickly show you where things are. Look at the map as I talk, and remember that you come in at the main entrance at the bottom.
Guide: Just inside the entrance you will find the cloakroom. It is the first building on your right.
Guide: As you come in through the main entrance, the cafeteria is the building straight ahead of you.
Guide: As you come in through the main entrance, the maritime gallery is the first building on your left.
Guide: The archive room is directly behind the cafeteria, at the back of the site.
Guide: The dinosaur hall is right next to the archive room, on its right side.
Guide: The cinema is directly behind the maritime gallery, at the back of the site.
Guide: That covers everything. Enjoy your visit.
Narrator: Map 2. The botanical garden.
Guide: Welcome to the botanical garden. I will quickly show you where things are. Look at the map as I talk, and remember that you come in at the main entrance at the bottom.
Guide: Just inside the entrance you will find the visitor centre. It is the building straight ahead of you.
Guide: As you come in through the main entrance, the souvenir stall is the first building on your right.
Guide: As you come in through the main entrance, the glasshouse is the first building on your left.
Guide: The cactus house is directly behind the glasshouse, at the back of the site.
Guide: The sculpture lawn is directly behind the souvenir stall, at the back of the site.
Guide: The herb garden is in the middle at the back, between the cactus house and the sculpture lawn.
Guide: That covers everything. Enjoy your visit.
Narrator: Map 3. The university campus.
Guide: Welcome to the university campus. I will quickly show you where things are. Look at the map as I talk, and remember that you come in at the main entrance at the bottom.
Guide: Just inside the entrance you will find the canteen. It is the first building on your right.
Guide: As you come in through the main entrance, the language lab is the building straight ahead of you.
Guide: Just inside the entrance you will find the art studio. It is the first building on your left.
Guide: The science block is directly behind the canteen, at the back of the site.
Guide: The library is directly behind the language lab, at the back of the site.
Guide: The bike shed is directly behind the art studio, at the back of the site.
Guide: That covers everything. Enjoy your visit.
Narrator: Map 4. The wildlife park.
Guide: Welcome to the wildlife park. I will quickly show you where things are. Look at the map as I talk, and remember that you come in at the main entrance at the bottom.
Guide: As you come in through the main entrance, the gift shop is the first building on your left.
Guide: As you come in through the main entrance, the café is the building straight ahead of you.
Guide: As you come in through the main entrance, the picnic area is the first building on your right.
Guide: The bird aviary is directly behind the picnic area, at the back of the site.
Guide: The first-aid post is directly behind the gift shop, at the back of the site.
Guide: The penguin pool is directly behind the café, at the back of the site.
Guide: That covers everything. Enjoy your visit.
